# Heightt

> Heightt is a financial management platform for student organisations and their members across Africa.

Heightt helps student organisations collect dues digitally, track payments, manage members, and maintain organised financial records. Students can view eligible dues, pay through available payment methods, and retain a record of successful payments.

## Main website

- [Heightt](https://www.heightt.app/): Product overview, audiences, workflow, roadmap, and frequently asked questions.

## Core capabilities

- Digital collection and automatic recording of student dues.
- Payment-status and collection tracking for student executives.
- Member and financial-record management for student organisations.
- A payment history for students.

## Intended users

- Student departments, faculties, associations, clubs, and societies.
- Student executives responsible for dues and financial records.
- Students paying organisation dues.

## Current product scope

Dues collection and management are the current core focus. Savings, wallets, and event tickets are roadmap features and should not be described as currently available.
